name: HolisticBias
description:
the HolisticBias dataset, is a set of sentences containing demographic identity language (e.g. "Hi! I am a Catholic grandmother."), used in the context of a two-person conversation. Sentences are formed by combining (1) an identity term from one of 13 demographic axes, (2) a noun referring to a person (mom, boy, grandparent, etc.), and (3) one of several dozen sentence templates.

paper_url = "https://aclanthology.org/2022.emnlp-main.625/"
